method: Actual official/local tourism, municipal, family-category, opening and association listings were relisted and compared to the frozen Product baseline. This is a bounded discovery sample of the listed entries, not an exhaustive census of every facility or municipality.

counting_rules.listing_entries_reviewed: Distinct (source URL, prefecture, resolved facility identity) entries actually compared. The same facility on different source lists counts once per list; same-page aliases collapse.
counting_rules.already_registered: Reviewed entry occurrences whose resolved identity exists in the pre-change baseline, including alias DUPLICATE entries.
counting_rules.candidates_found: Unique surfaced unresolved identities. ADD, DUPLICATE and HOLD are mutually exclusive. Same-facility aliases share one candidate. Direct known matches are not candidates.
counting_rules.inequality: Both requested identities are asserted for each prefecture. Because DUPLICATE overlaps already_registered, these are not disjoint buckets; repeated appearances of new/HOLD identities on independent lists also contribute to reviewed entries.

methodology_result.limitation: Absence from the reviewed prefectural list is not proof of absence from the entire prefectural website. This run demonstrates real canon gaps and local-association discovery, without claiming such global absence.
